name: Rice Chapati
ingredients:
refined oil as required
salt as required
2 cup rice flour
2 cup water
directions:
To prepare this rice roti, place a kadhai over medium flame and boil 2 cups of water in it. Add oil and salt to it.

Next, add rice flour in the boiling water and mix well. Turn off the flame and keep aside.

Take a large bowl and put the mixture in it. Knead until it become as soft as chapati dough. Make small balls out of the dough and roll them into small chapatis.

Heat a tawa over medium flame and put the chapatis on it. Carefully, flip both sides of the chapatti till it turns crispy. Serve warm with any side dish of your choice.
